name: European Long distance path E1 - Finland
description_md:
The European Long distance path E1 in Finland is a waymarked hiking route covering 72.5 km. It features 1370 m of ascent and 1624 m of descent, with a walking time of about 22 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule.

The route is signposted as E1 and is part of an international waymarked hiking network. Its difficulty is moderate, derived from distance and ascent. The line matches the official route published by turrutebasen.
